name: Four-panel Story Prompts
prompt:
Create a landscape four-panel picture sequence for English speaking and typing practice. Story brief: {{story}}. Arrange four equally sized panels from left to right, with clear gutters. Show one key event per panel in a logically readable order, with consistent original characters, objects, and setting.
Use a clean, friendly illustration style and emphasize visible actions, changes, and cause and effect. Keep background details restrained so an A2-B1 learner can describe what happens; more advanced learners can add their own connections. Do not introduce an unexplained extra event or change a character's identity between panels.
Use no text at all: no captions, panel numbers, speech bubbles, signs, labels, or letters. The result should invite learners to write their own sentences rather than reveal a prewritten answer. Do not depict real people or use a recognizable copyrighted character.

Use original, generic subjects, with no logos, branded characters, or imitation of a named artist. Do not add a watermark, decorative writing, labels, letters, or numerals. Keep every panel completely text-free.
description: Generate a wordless story sequence for describing events and writing short sentences.

variables.name: story
variables.default: A person plants a seed, waters it, sees a sprout, and later picks a flower.
variables.description: A fictional four-step sequence with a clear beginning and end.
